title: Millicent Fawcett's birth chart
metaDescription: Millicent Fawcett's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.9° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mars holds a square to Jupiter at 0.4° — close enough to weld drive to expansion. A square is the tradition’s engine room: two drives at cross purposes, and the friction is the horsepower.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 19.9° of Gemini is the Sun's exact seat — second decan, 10°–20°, sub-ruled by Venus in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 27.8° Gemini, Venus at 0.8° Leo, Mars at 26.2° Pisces. Mercury in an air sign reads as thought that travels by comparison; Venus in a fire sign reads as attraction declared rather than implied; Mars in a water sign reads as effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Jupiter and Pluto hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 0.0° wide. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not. Behind it, Mars square Jupiter at 0.4°, and Mercury conjunction Jupiter at 1.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: No closed figure — no grand trine, t-square, or grand cross — holds among the day-stable angles. The chart distributes its tension pair by pair rather than through one standing structure.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags two placements in this chart. Mercury in Gemini at 27.8° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Gemini at 26.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 air, 3 fire, 3 water by element and 6 mutable, 2 cardinal, 1 fixed by modality. Air signs carry exchange in the scheme — comparison, argument, the sentence that makes the situation legible. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Neptune was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Taurus into Gemini during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.0° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
